items.t: CVT shudder, whine and failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used CVT costs less. Fresh Nissan CVT fluid may help a mild case first. AWD models take longer.

items.t: Intake air duct cracks or separates (recall)
items.job: Replace intake air ducts and resonator
items.note: Free under Nissan's intake duct recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Camshaft or crankshaft position sensor failure
items.job: Replace camshaft or crankshaft position sensor
items.note: Price is for one sensor. Early 2003 models may be covered by a sensor recall, so check the VIN first.

items.t: Gear shown may not match gear engaged (recall)
items.job: Check and tighten transmission selector shaft nut
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Alternator stops charging (recall)
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Recall replaced it with a modified alternator. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer first.

items.t: Fuel tank can be punctured by road debris (recall)
items.job: Install fuel tank protector
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. If the tank is already punctured, replacing it costs much more.

items.t: Fuel tank vapor fitting can come off (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank
items.note: The recall fix is a new fuel tank at no charge. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rear seat belt webbing can be cut (recall)
items.job: Install rear seat belt webbing protectors
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. A belt that is already frayed must be replaced, which costs more.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel lock assembly
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off (recall)
items.job: Test occupant sensor; replace seat cushion sensor if needed
items.note: Free under recall. Low end is a test only; high end includes a new seat cushion with sensor. Check the VIN.

items.t: Brake valves may not close fully (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace ABS actuator
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. Includes brake bleeding.

items.t: Tire pressure sensor nut can corrode and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace tire pressure sensor valve nuts
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. A sensor that is badly corroded may need replacing, which costs more.

items.t: Tire pressure monitor not switched on at the factory (recall)
items.job: Activate tire pressure monitoring system
items.note: Labor-only setup done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Power steering hose can come off (recall)
items.job: Install high-pressure power steering hose kit
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: ABS unit can leak and short out (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and replace ABS actuator
items.note: Free under recall; many cars only need an inspection. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT judder and hesitation
items.job: CVT software update and fluid change
items.note: If the CVT must be replaced, expect much more. Ask a dealer about extended CVT coverage for your VIN.

items.t: Transfer case fluid leak on AWD models
items.job: Replace transfer case axle seal
items.note: If the seal keeps leaking or the case is damaged, replacing the transfer case costs much more.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Reprogram airbag and occupant sensor control units
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rear camera image can be hidden (recall)
items.job: Update display software settings
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Weak steering knuckle or rear axle housing (recall)
items.job: Replace steering knuckle or rear axle housing
items.note: Price is per side; add a wheel alignment. Free under recall, so check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front brake caliper may break (recall)
items.job: Replace both front brake calipers
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. Includes bleeding the brakes.

items.t: Backup camera may not show (recall)
items.job: Update camera and display software
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. If the camera itself fails, replacing it costs much more.
